label: Kimi K3.1 Pro
output:
To: #team-selection
Replying to: s01
Cc: none
Subject: none

Marek,

I disagree with Liliana Bąk being named only as reserve and ask you to revise the proposal before the names are submitted on Friday. This is about applying the selection criteria consistently, not about Igor personally.

On 1 October, you wrote that selection would consider both the November FIDE list and form in club events, specifically including the rapid qualifier on 24 October. You also wrote that the players’ coaches would be consulted before the final lineup. As Liliana’s coach, I was not consulted, and the published lineup appears to rely on the rating list alone.

That list does not show the full picture. Liliana’s entire -81 change comes from the Katowice Open. For health reasons, she was below her normal level there but still played every game. I therefore do not think the resulting rating fairly represents her real strength. She missed approximately two weeks of training in October, but she is now back at her normal level, and her last three lessons have been very good.

By contrast, her club-event form supports her selection. In the rapid qualifier, Liliana finished second with 5.5/7, beating Maja and Antoni and drawing with Kacper. Igor finished fourth with 4/7. This was one of the two criteria you announced, so it should carry real weight alongside the ratings.

I want to be clear that I have nothing against Igor. He is a good boy and, as Rafael says, he has been steady this autumn. The issue is simply whether we follow the rule that was communicated to everyone.

On that basis, Liliana should be on board 2. If you believe a further direct comparison is necessary, I am also willing to accept a short match between Liliana and Igor before Friday, with board 2 decided on that basis. I can help arrange it immediately.

Please change the current proposal before Friday, either by naming Liliana on board 2 or by organising this match and settling the place before submission. I would appreciate your confirmation of which solution you will apply.

Oksana
